{{Quote|This holoprojection was a gift from Queen Ressa of Drezzi to thank Darth Nyriss for her merciful treatment of the royal family when the Empire conquered their world. Her husband was executed, but the queen and her children were spared.|Sechel|<ref name="Revan" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' was the [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of [[Queen]] [[Ressa]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drezzi]]. After Drezzi was [[Conquest of Drezzi|conquered]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]<ref name="Revan" /> [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to [[3954 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the man was [[Death/Legends|executed]]. Ressa and her [[Youngling/Legends|children]], however, were spared by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nyriss]]. In gratitude for allowing her and her children to live, the Ressa gave Nyriss a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojection]] as a gift of thanks. [[Sechel]], a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to Darth Nyriss, later recounted to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] the tale behind the holoprojection gift and Ressa's family while Sechel took Scourge to meet with Nyriss in her [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold|stronghold]] on the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ressa's husband was mentioned in ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', a [[2011]] novel written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="Revan" />
